name: Swagger Testcase MCP
description: MCP server for API test case generation from Swagger/OpenAPI specs. Parses Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.x, generates test cases across 8 categories (positive, negative, boundary, auth, security, idempotency, pagination, business logic), and exports to Postman, TestRail, Allure, k6, pytest, Gherkin, and CSV. Supports internal corporate APIs with auth headers. Auto-saves export files to your working di
